category: Cold-storage backup, subscription (lifetime SKUs exist via deal sites)

egress.terms: Not published as a fee; cold-tier retrieval is the practical cost and is not quantified on the pricing page

interface_detail: Windows client, S3-ish 'Instant Vault' for the hot portion
tooling: no rclone/WebDAV found for the cold tier
chaining: poor — cold tier is restore-on-request, not a filesystem
limits_note: Constraint type: write-gated — cold storage means the restore is a request workflow. File upload size 20 GB on the small tier.
reliability_note: Same corporate family as Polarbackup, which revoked paid lifetime deals outright. Zoolz's own $34.99-$49.99 '1 TB lifetime' SKUs sold through Cult of Mac / BleepingComputer / Mashable stacks are the classic revocable instrument.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Zoolz Cloud Backup 12 TB ... 10 TB Cold Storage + 2 TB Hot Storage ... $399.99 Yearly'

binding_note: no constraint in the record binds at this scale; the record carries no limit of a kind the vocabulary names
